nodes.name: Bow
nodes.text: A starting point. Starts you didn't pick are walk-through nodes.

nodes.name: Melee mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Momentum
choices.text: Each hit in a row on the same target gives +4% damage (up to +20%); resets after 3 s without a hit.

choices.name: Sunder
choices.text: Your hits lower the target's armor by 10% for 5 s.

nodes.name: Blade Dancer
nodes.text: +12% sword damage and +15% sweeping attack damage.

choices.name: Cleaver (B)
choices.text: Axes disable shields 1 s longer; +4% axe damage.

nodes.name: Shieldbreaker
nodes.text: Axe hits disable shields 2 seconds longer; +10% axe damage.

nodes.name: Earthshaker
nodes.text: Mace smash attacks hit 1 block wider; +12% smash damage.

nodes.name: Precision
nodes.text: +5% critical hit chance; critical hits deal +20% damage.

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.text: Sweeping attacks hit every enemy around you (up to 5), not just the ones in front.

nodes.name: Executioner
nodes.text: Deal 40% more damage to enemies below 30% health.

nodes.name: Defense mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Riposte
choices.text: Blocking a hit with a shield makes your next hit within 3 s deal +30% damage.

nodes.name: Perfect Parry
nodes.text: Blocking right before a hit lands reflects 30% of its damage back.

nodes.name: Fireproof
nodes.text: -40% burning time and +20% explosion knockback resistance.

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.text: The first hit you take every 10 seconds deals 50% less damage (an icon shows when it is ready).

nodes.name: Unshakable
nodes.text: You are immune to knockback while blocking or sneaking.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.text: Taking a hit bigger than 25% of your health gives Resistance I for 4 seconds (once every 20 seconds).

nodes.name: Vitality mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Blood Pact
choices.text: Heal for 2% of the damage you deal.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.text: Below 30% health you regenerate 3x faster for 5 seconds (once a minute).

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.text: Below 25% health you take 20% less damage.

nodes.name: Ever-Mending
nodes.text: Natural regeneration keeps working even when your hunger bar is low.

nodes.name: Mobility mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Runner's High
choices.text: After 3 s of sprinting, +10% movement speed until you stop.

choices.name: Acrobat
choices.text: +0.5 block step height and +10% jump strength.

nodes.name: Fleet Foot
nodes.text: +8% movement speed and you walk up full blocks without jumping.

nodes.name: Cat's Grace
nodes.text: +4 blocks safe fall distance and -25% fall damage.

nodes.name: Dolphin Kick
nodes.text: +20% swim speed; sprint-swimming costs no hunger.

choices.name: Horseman (B)
choices.text: Mounts you ride get +10% jump and take 20% less fall damage.

nodes.name: Rider
nodes.text: Mounts you ride get +15% speed and jump.

nodes.name: Featherfall
nodes.text: -50% fall damage and +6 blocks safe fall distance.

nodes.name: Pathfinder
nodes.text: +15% movement speed and -50% hunger from sprinting.

choices.name: B
choices.text: +3% chance not to use an arrow

nodes.name: Ranged mastery
nodes.text: Pick one of two strong effects.

choices.name: Deadeye
choices.text: Fully drawn bow shots deal +20% damage.

choices.name: Long Shot
choices.text: +25% projectile damage against targets over 20 blocks away.

nodes.name: Eagle Eye
nodes.text: Fully drawn bow shots deal +15% damage and fly 15% faster.

nodes.name: Tide Caller
nodes.text: Thrown tridents return 30% faster and deal +15% damage in rain or water.
